scenes.title: Skipping your 401(k) match is skipping free money
scenes.say: If you skip your employer match, you're turning down free money.

scenes.label: a common match: 50 cents per dollar, up to 6% of pay
scenes.say: A common match is fifty cents for every dollar, up to six percent of your pay.

scenes.title: On a $60,000 salary
scenes.say: On sixty thousand, you put in thirty six hundred. Your employer adds eighteen hundred more.

scenes.title: Always grab the full match.
scenes.say: That's an instant fifty percent. Follow for more money math.
